findings.text: follow-on: garbage_collect calls `_release_worktree_whole` at routing.py:2232 and :2246 and ignores the returned `released` flag, so a withheld refusal there is still appended to `removed`; gc's candidate filter (routing.py:2133) deliberately admits registered worktrees under the runs root, and `_release_withhold_reason` refuses those as "outside the managed worktree root", so such a tree is reported removed while it is never moved — the refusal read as a completed removal that commit 9e22cdd06's own message says it prevents.

follow-on: `_main_worktree` re-implements the main-checkout resolution owned by reckon/crew/node.py:1340 `repository_identity` (same `--path-format=absolute --git-common-dir` probe and `.git`-parent rule) instead of calling it, duplicating a capability the repository already owns.

follow-on: the fragment records "Gate at head d3e4b44f7: 7 passed in the release suite" although it was edited after that revision and the node's final head is 9e22cdd06 with 10 release-suite cases, so the recorded gate is stale relative to the revision the fragment now describes.

item_verdicts.diff: read commits ddd0008de and 9e22cdd06 against base 39b5e7122 commit by commit; both stay inside the declared scope and change only the three source/test files and the evidence fragment.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names tests/test_a_worktree_release_is_whole.py; the manifest records that file at 10 passed EXIT=0 (gate-newfile.log) and the negative control at EXIT=1, and the gained commit adds the caller-enumerating test at tests/test_a_worktree_release_is_whole.py:392.
item_verdicts.goal: the node goal is that one helper owns every worktree removal, vacating the registered path in a single rename onto a same-filesystem trash directory, deregistering that one tree and deleting the copy with no deadline; the gained commits keep reckon/crew/routing.py:1229 `_release_worktree_whole` as that owner and add the refusal at routing.py:1185 for a path that is not a disposable linked worktree.
item_verdicts.manifest: read manifest.md; status complete at head 9e22cdd06, gates 10/3/27/8 passed EXIT=0, negative control EXIT=1, and evidence_inputs candidly records that the base arm imported head code through the shared editable install.
item_verdicts.write_paths: read the manifest's declared paths; every path in the gained diff — reckon/crew/routing.py, reckon/crew/promotion_release.py, tests/test_a_worktree_release_is_whole.py and docs/evidence/fragments/crew-runtime-positive-controls/a-worktree-release-is-whole.html — is inside them.

justifications.durability: tests/test_a_worktree_release_is_whole.py:252 and :281 fail if the blanket prune or the missing linked-worktree guard is reinstated, as negative-control.log shows (3 failed EXIT=1) while gate-newfile.log stays at 10 passed.
justifications.evidence: gate-newfile.log records 10 passed EXIT=0 at head 9e22cdd06 and negative-control.log records 3 failed 7 passed EXIT=1, but the only population arm (head-arm.log) ran at d3e4b44f7, so no population result covers the final revision.
justifications.fit: reckon/crew/routing.py:1119-1194 names mechanism helpers (`_worktree_registrations`, `_release_withhold_reason`, `_worktree_admin_dir`) with no plan label, matching the module's surrounding style.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/routing.py:1229 renames the tree aside, deletes its own administrative directory and the copy with no deadline, and reckon/crew/promotion_release.py:410 records worktree_withheld rather than a release when the path is not a disposable tree.
justifications.reuse: reckon/crew/routing.py:1154 `_main_worktree` duplicates reckon/crew/node.py:1340 `repository_identity`, which already resolves a path to its main checkout through `--path-format=absolute --git-common-dir`.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in the gained diff is inside the declared write paths, and the out-of-fence caller-test edit of the earlier commits is left untouched by these two commits.
